findings: F-M3-03: idempotency is by business key (BR-01/BR-02) in the batch and by (shipment, carrier) key in the saga. A replay with a changed business key (e.g. a shifted event_time) is a new fact and is NOT caught. Stated limit, not a defect.
hypothesis: Replayed events do not create second facts, and replayed booking requests do not create second bookings.
method: (A) append 40 replayed tracking events (new event ids, same business key and sequence number) and run the ETL; (B) run the ETL twice on the same input; (C) replay one booking request 50 times, then 20 times concurrently, then after a simulated restart on the same store file.
name: Duplicate event replay against idempotency
pass_criteria: all replayed events quarantined, none curated, curated count unchanged
exactly one carrier call and one live booking per shipment, also concurrently and after restart
